statement: A qualified publication tag is an annotated tag object whose signature verifies against a signer named here by fingerprint. GitHub required_signatures verifies commits, ruleset update/deletion rules give immutability, and gh release create writes a lightweight tag; none of the three is a signed tag.
key_material: Fingerprints only. Public keys live in an operator-supplied allowed-signers file that is never committed; tools/tag_signing.py refuses any principal in that file whose fingerprint is absent here.
blocked_on: No publication signing key has been nominated. Until the release owner adds one authorized signer, no publication tag can be produced or trusted, and #236's signed-tag criterion stays unmet.

geospatial-grpc.qualification: native protocol releases; signer not nominated

honua-helm.qualification: native chart releases; signer not nominated

honua-release.qualification: platform publication tags; signer not nominated. The promotion workflow currently creates this tag through gh release create, which is lightweight and unsignable; it must move to this producer before the candidate is cut.

honua-sdk-dotnet.qualification: native NuGet releases; signer not nominated

honua-sdk-python.qualification: native wheel releases; signer not nominated
